dsh-save-money#plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Pause and resume tasks automatically during user-defined time windows to avoid peak-hour API costs; includes account balance display and 10-minute granularity spend bar chart.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8ddf82aa782eea839e7d.html
